laptops.summary: Lengthened the round to 2 minutes and pushed it to main. Built two features on separate branches: a pause key (P or Escape), and an enemy feature that spawns an extra drone every 15 seconds and, in a second session, gives the drones random powers. Then resolved conflicts and merged both into main; a teammate later merged main with the other branches. No feature was left unmerged.
laptops.notes: Practice run, not the real lab. The main session started in the home folder and worked on coin-dash through scratchpad clones and the repository itself. The enemy-power session ran in a separate clone (coin-dash-enemy) and was started by the student, not as a subagent. Both sessions ran in auto mode, so no permission prompts were logged; the only waiting time is one question the agent asked. A background-task notification arrived at 13:13:31Z with no reply logged, so it is not counted. This reporting session is left out.
